newsitem.title: GERMANY: TENNIS-BECKER, STICH TO PLAY GERMAN RELEGATION TIE.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-BECKER, STICH TO PLAY GERMAN RELEGATION TIE.

text.p: Boris Becker and Michael Stich have both promised to play for Germany in their Davis Cup relegation playoff in September, the German Tennis Federation (DTB) said on Friday.
Both were criticised in the German media for not playing in last weekend's first round tie on clay against Spain.
The Spaniards, led by Australian Open finalist Carlos Moya, won 4-1, forcing the three-times winners into a playoff to stay in the world group next year.
Their opponents for the tie have not yet been determined.
